questions: Is the $29.99 monthly rate guaranteed for the full 24-month initial term, or can it increase?

letter.body:
IronHouse Member Services
P.O. Box 7781
Columbus, OH 43216

[Date]

Dear IronHouse Member Services,

I am writing to formally request the cancellation of my gym membership, associated with [Your name] and Member/Account number [Member/Account number].

I understand that this request must be received at least thirty (30) days before my next billing date to avoid further charges.

Please send confirmation of my membership cancellation and the effective date to my address below.

Sincerely,
[Your name]
[Your address]

text:
IRONHOUSE FITNESS CLUBS LLC
MEMBERSHIP AGREEMENT — "CORE 24" PLAN

Member: ____________________   Home Club: IronHouse Riverside, 410 Mill Street, Dayton, OH 45402
Start Date: ____________________

1. MEMBERSHIP DUES. Member agrees to pay monthly dues of $29.99, charged on the 1st of each month to the payment method on file, for a minimum term of twenty-four (24) months ("Initial Term").

2. ENROLLMENT FEE. A one-time enrollment fee of $49.00 is due at signing. This fee is non-refundable under any circumstances.

3. ANNUAL CLUB ENHANCEMENT FEE. An annual club enhancement fee of $59.00 will be charged on March 1 of each year of membership, beginning with the first March 1 after the Start Date.

4. PRICE CHANGES. IronHouse may change the monthly dues or any fee at any time by giving Member thirty (30) days' notice by email or by posting at the front desk. Continued use of the club after the notice period means Member accepts the new price.

5. AUTOMATIC RENEWAL. At the end of the Initial Term, this membership automatically continues on a month-to-month basis at the then-current standard rate, currently $39.99 per month, until cancelled in accordance with Section 7.

6. EARLY CANCELLATION. If Member cancels before the end of the Initial Term for any reason other than those listed in Section 8, Member must pay an early cancellation fee equal to fifty percent (50%) of the dues remaining in the Initial Term.

7. HOW TO CANCEL. Cancellation requests must be made in writing and delivered by certified mail to IronHouse Member Services, P.O. Box 7781, Columbus, OH 43216, at least thirty (30) days before the next billing date. Cancellations by phone, email, or at the front desk will not be accepted.

8. CANCELLATION WITHOUT PENALTY. Member may cancel without the early cancellation fee (a) within three (3) business days of signing, or (b) upon permanent relocation more than 25 miles from any IronHouse club, or (c) upon a physician's written statement that Member cannot use the facilities, in each case with written notice as described in Section 7.

9. MEMBERSHIP FREEZE. Member may freeze the membership for 1 to 3 months per year for a fee of $10.00 per frozen month. The Initial Term is extended by the length of any freeze.

10. GUEST PRIVILEGES. Member may bring one guest per month at no charge. The guest must be at least 18 years of age and sign a waiver.

11. LIABILITY. Member uses the facilities at Member's own risk. IronHouse is not responsible for lost or stolen property or for injuries, except those caused by IronHouse's gross negligence.

12. DISPUTES. Any dispute arising from this Agreement shall be resolved by binding individual arbitration in Franklin County, Ohio. Member waives the right to participate in a class action.

13. ENTIRE AGREEMENT. This Agreement is the entire agreement between the parties. Verbal promises made by staff are not part of this Agreement.

Member Signature: ____________________   Date: __________

clauses.quote: Member agrees to pay monthly dues of $29.99, charged on the 1st of each month to the payment method on file, for a minimum term of twenty-four (24) months ("Initial Term").
clauses.title: Fixed monthly dues
clauses.meaning: You pay $29.99 each month for 24 months. This price is set for the initial term.
clauses.whyItMatters: Your monthly payment is clear for the first two years. This is the main cost.
clauses.whatToDo: Confirm the $29.99 monthly rate is guaranteed for the full 24 months.

clauses.quote: A one-time enrollment fee of $49.00 is due at signing. This fee is non-refundable under any circumstances.
clauses.title: Non-refundable enrollment fee
clauses.meaning: You pay $49.00 when you sign. You will not get this money back, even if you cancel quickly.
clauses.whyItMatters: This is an upfront cost of $49.00. You lose it if you change your mind.
clauses.whatToDo: Ask if the enrollment fee can be waived or reduced.

clauses.quote: An annual club enhancement fee of $59.00 will be charged on March 1 of each year of membership, beginning with the first March 1 after the Start Date.
clauses.title: Annual fee
clauses.meaning: You will pay an extra $59.00 every year on March 1. This is in addition to your monthly dues.
clauses.whyItMatters: This adds $59.00 to your costs in the first year and another $59.00 in the second year. It is not part of the monthly dues.
clauses.whatToDo: Ask if the annual fee can be waived or if your start date can be adjusted to avoid an early charge.

clauses.quote: IronHouse may change the monthly dues or any fee at any time by giving Member thirty (30) days' notice by email or by posting at the front desk. Continued use of the club after the notice period means Member accepts the new price.
clauses.title: They can raise the price anytime
clauses.meaning: IronHouse can increase your monthly dues or other fees. They will tell you 30 days before the change. If you keep using the gym, you agree to the new price.
clauses.whyItMatters: Your $29.99 monthly rate is only fixed for the initial 24 months. After that, IronHouse can raise it. They can also raise the annual fee or other fees during your initial term.
clauses.whatToDo: Ask if the monthly dues and annual fee are guaranteed not to increase during your 24-month initial term. Get it in writing.

clauses.quote: At the end of the Initial Term, this membership automatically continues on a month-to-month basis at the then-current standard rate, currently $39.99 per month, until cancelled in accordance with Section 7.
clauses.title: Auto-renews at higher price
clauses.meaning: After 24 months, your membership automatically continues. You will pay $39.99 per month, or whatever the standard rate is then. It will keep renewing monthly until you cancel.
clauses.whyItMatters: Your monthly cost jumps from $29.99 to $39.99 after two years. You must actively cancel to stop paying this higher rate.
clauses.whatToDo: Mark your calendar to review your membership before the 24-month initial term ends. Decide if you want to continue at the higher rate.

clauses.quote: If Member cancels before the end of the Initial Term for any reason other than those listed in Section 8, Member must pay an early cancellation fee equal to fifty percent (50%) of the dues remaining in the Initial Term.
clauses.title: Expensive early exit
clauses.meaning: If you cancel early, you must pay half of the remaining monthly dues for your 24-month term. There are only a few exceptions.
clauses.whyItMatters: If you cancel after 12 months, you still owe 50% of the remaining 12 months of dues. That is 6 months of dues, or $179.94 ($29.99 x 6).
clauses.whatToDo: Be sure you can commit for 24 months. Understand the cost if you need to leave early.

clauses.quote: Cancellation requests must be made in writing and delivered by certified mail to IronHouse Member Services, P.O. Box 7781, Columbus, OH 43216, at least thirty (30) days before the next billing date. Cancellations by phone, email, or at the front desk will not be accepted.
clauses.title: Hard to cancel
clauses.meaning: You cannot cancel by phone, email, or in person. You must send a letter by certified mail to a specific address. It must arrive at least 30 days before your next bill.
clauses.whyItMatters: This makes cancelling difficult. You need to plan ahead and use certified mail. If you miss the deadline, you pay for another month.
clauses.whatToDo: Keep the cancellation address handy. Send your letter well in advance of the 30-day deadline.

clauses.quote: Member may freeze the membership for 1 to 3 months per year for a fee of $10.00 per frozen month. The Initial Term is extended by the length of any freeze.
clauses.title: Freezing costs money
clauses.meaning: You can pause your membership for 1 to 3 months each year. You pay $10.00 for each month it is frozen. The 24-month term gets longer by the freeze time.
clauses.whyItMatters: A freeze costs you $10.00 per month. It also extends your 24-month commitment. This means you pay the $29.99 rate for longer, delaying the higher month-to-month rate.
clauses.whatToDo: Consider if a freeze is worth the $10.00 fee and extended commitment. Compare it to just paying the monthly dues.

clauses.quote: Any dispute arising from this Agreement shall be resolved by binding individual arbitration in Franklin County, Ohio. Member waives the right to participate in a class action.
clauses.title: No lawsuits, no class actions
clauses.meaning: If you have a problem with IronHouse, you cannot sue them in court. You must go to arbitration. You also cannot join a group lawsuit with other members.
clauses.whyItMatters: Arbitration can be less formal than court, but you lose your right to a jury trial. You cannot join with others if many people have the same issue.
clauses.whatToDo: Understand that your options for resolving disputes are limited to individual arbitration.
